Conduct analysis of alerts, tools and associated data to identify false positives, improve detection and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of investigative processes. Improve predictive analytics models and associated real-time monitoring solutions, including developing, testing, and refining detection logic and use cases in collaboration with Security Engineering. Build dashboards, queries and specialised monitoring capabilities to support investigations, including sensitive or close-hold Insider Risk activities. Develop scripts and automated workflows to streamline data correlation, alert enrichment, investigative analysis and reporting. Conduct proactive analysis of emerging insider risk trends to determine prevalence of threats in Experian's environment. Produce documentation, including SOPs, process flows, and reporting and metrics using a variety of tools and information sources (SIEM, UEBA, project and knowledge management systems, case management systems, etc.). Provide operational cross-coverage for Insider Risk and DLP governance activities, including investigations, policy and exception reviews, and business engagement, following established procedures and escalation requirements. Demonstrated hands-on SIEM expertise developing complex queries, correlation searches, dashboards, and content from scratch, using YARA-L, SPL, KQL, SQL, or equivalent query and detection languages. Experience in insider risk, cybersecurity investigations, security analytics, or a related technical security discipline. Experience in mitigating insider threats and managing insider risk by utilizing UEBA and DLP tools. Coordinar iniciativas y programas de Salud y Seguridad en el Trabajo en los diferentes países de la región. 7. Gestionar procesos de terminación laboral, revisando el cumplimiento de los controles, aprobaciones y requerimientos legales. 8.
